answer: Farming becomes a cedar bet on surviving 84 epochs of grading, and every dune settlement recomputes the lantern schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 84 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 35 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
